verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֔וּ צָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן כִּֽי־ בְנֵ֤י הַגּוֹלָה֙ בּוֹנִ֣ים הֵיכָ֔ל לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·mə·‘ū ṣā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇin·yā·min kî- ḇə·nê hag·gō·w·lāh bō·w·nîm hê·ḵāl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: When the enemies of Judah and Benjamin heard that the exiles . . . were building a temple for the LORD the God of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ouvindo os adversários de Judá e de Benjamim que os filhos do cativeiro edificavam um templo a Jeová, Deus de Israel,

verses.original: וַיִּגְּשׁ֨וּ אֶל־ זְרֻבָּבֶ֜ל וְאֶל־ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֗וֹת וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ לָהֶם֙ נִבְנֶ֣ה עִמָּכֶ֔ם כִּ֣י כָכֶ֔ם נִדְר֖וֹשׁ לֵֽאלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְלֹא אֲנַ֣חְנוּ זֹבְחִ֗ים מִימֵי֙ אֵסַ֤ר חַדֹּן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר הַמַּעֲלֶ֥ה אֹתָ֖נוּ פֹּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gə·šū ’el- zə·rub·bā·ḇel wə·’el- rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ way·yō·mə·rū lā·hem niḇ·neh ‘im·mā·ḵem kî ḵā·ḵem niḏ·rō·wōš lê·lō·hê·ḵem wə·lō ’ă·naḥ·nū zō·ḇə·ḥîm mî·mê ’ê·sar ḥad·dōn me·leḵ ’aš·šūr ham·ma·‘ă·leh ’ō·ṯā·nū pōh
verses.literal: they approached . . . Zerubbabel . . . and the heads of the families saying . . . Let us build with you because like you we seek your God . . . and have been sacrificing to Him since the time of King Esar-haddon of Assyria who brought us here
verses.literalPt: chegaram-se a Zorobabel e aos cabeças das famílias e disseram-lhes: Deixai-nos edificar convosco, pois buscamos ao vosso Deus, assim como vós; e nós lhe temos sacrificado desde os dias de Esar-Hadom, rei da Assíria, que nos fez subir para aqui.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ לָהֶ֨ם זְרֻבָּבֶ֜ל וְיֵשׁ֗וּעַ וּשְׁאָ֨ר רָאשֵׁ֤י הָֽאָבוֹת֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹֽא־ לָ֣כֶם וָלָ֔נוּ לִבְנ֥וֹת בַּ֖יִת לֵאלֹהֵ֑ינוּ כִּי֩ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ יַ֜חַד נִבְנֶ֗ה לַֽיהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔נוּ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ כּ֥וֹרֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ פָּרָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·hem zə·rub·bā·ḇel wə·yê·šū·a‘ ū·šə·’ār rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lə·yiś·rā·’êl lō- lā·ḵem wā·lā·nū liḇ·nō·wṯ ba·yiṯ lê·lō·hê·nū kî ’ă·naḥ·nū ya·ḥaḏ niḇ·neh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wā·nū ham·me·leḵ kō·w·reš me·leḵ- pā·rās
verses.literal: But Zerubbabel Jeshua and the other heads of the families of Israel replied You have no part with us in building a house for our God since we alone must build it for the LORD the God of Israel as Cyrus king of Persia has commanded us
verses.literalPt: Responderam-lhes, porém, Zorobabel, e Jesua, e os outros cabeças das famílias de Israel: Não nos convém edificar convosco uma casa ao nosso Deus; mas nós mesmos, sós, a edificaremos a Jeová, Deus de Israel, como nos ordenou Ciro, rei da Pérsia.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ עַם־ הָאָ֔רֶץ מְרַפִּ֖ים יְדֵ֣י עַם־ יְהוּדָ֑ה וּמְבַלַהִים אוֹתָ֖ם לִבְנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ‘am- hā·’ā·reṣ mə·rap·pîm yə·ḏê ‘am- yə·hū·ḏāh ū·mə·ḇa·la·hīm ’ō·w·ṯām liḇ·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then the people of the land set out to discourage . . . the people of Judah and make them afraid to build
verses.literalPt: Então, o povo da terra enfraqueceu as mãos do povo de Judá, e os perturbou no trabalho de edificar,

verses.original: וְסֹכְרִ֧ים עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם יוֹעֲצִ֖ים לְהָפֵ֣ר עֲצָתָ֑ם כָּל־ יְמֵ֗י כּ֚וֹרֶשׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס וְעַד־ מַלְכ֖וּת דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ פָּרָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sō·ḵə·rîm ‘ă·lê·hem yō·w·‘ă·ṣîm lə·hā·p̄êr ‘ă·ṣā·ṯām kāl- yə·mê kō·w·reš me·leḵ pā·ras wə·‘aḏ- mal·ḵūṯ dā·rə·yā·weš me·leḵ- pā·rās
verses.literal: They hired counselors against them to frustrate their plans throughout the reign of Cyrus king of Persia and down to the reign of Darius king of Persia
verses.literalPt: e alugou contra eles conselheiros, para lhes frustrar o desígnio por todos os dias de Ciro, rei da Pérsia, até o reinado de Dario, rei da Pérsia.

verses.original: וּבְמַלְכוּת֙ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ בִּתְחִלַּ֖ת מַלְכוּת֑וֹ כָּתְב֣וּ שִׂטְנָ֔ה עַל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·mal·ḵūṯ ’ă·ḥaš·wê·rō·wōš biṯ·ḥil·laṯ mal·ḵū·ṯōw kā·ṯə·ḇū śiṭ·nāh ‘al- yō·šə·ḇê yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: At the beginning . . . of the reign of Xerxes an accusation was lodged against the people of Judah and Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: No reinado de Assuero, no princípio do seu reinado, escreveram uma acusação contra os habitantes de Judá e de Jerusalém.

verses.original: וּבִימֵ֣י אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֗שְׂתָּא כָּתַ֨ב בִּשְׁלָ֜ם מִתְרְדָ֤ת טָֽבְאֵל֙ וּשְׁאָ֣ר כְּנָוֹתוֹ עַל־ אַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתָּא מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרָ֑ס וּכְתָב֙ הַֽנִּשְׁתְּוָ֔ן כָּת֥וּב אֲרָמִ֖ית וּמְתֻרְגָּ֥ם אֲרָמִֽית׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇî·mê ’ar·taḥ·šaś·tā kā·ṯaḇ biš·lām miṯ·rə·ḏāṯ ṭā·ḇə·’êl ū·šə·’ār kə·nå̄·wō·ṯō ‘al- ʾar·taḥ·šaś·tå̄ me·leḵ pā·rās ū·ḵə·ṯāḇ han·niš·tə·wān kā·ṯūḇ ’ă·rā·mîṯ ū·mə·ṯur·gām ’ă·rā·mîṯ
verses.literal: And in the days of Artaxerxes king of Persia Bishlam Mithredath Tabeel and the rest of his associates wrote a letter to Artaxerxes It was written in Aramaic and then translated
verses.literalPt: Nos dias de Artaxerxes, escreveram Bislão, Mitredate, Tabeel e o resto dos seus companheiros a Artaxerxes, rei da Pérsia; e a carta foi escrita com caracteres aramaicos e vazada em aramaico.

verses.original: רְח֣וּם בְּעֵל־ טְעֵ֗ם וְשִׁמְשַׁי֙ סָֽפְרָ֔א כְּתַ֛בוּ אִגְּרָ֥ה חֲדָ֖ה עַל־ יְרוּשְׁלֶ֑ם לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁ֥שְׂתְּא מַלְכָּ֖א כְּנֵֽמָא׃
verses.transliteration: rə·ḥūm bə·‘êl- ṭə·‘êm wə·šim·šay sā·p̄ə·rā kə·ṯa·ḇū ’ig·gə·rāh ḥă·ḏāh ‘al- yə·rū·šə·lem lə·’ar·taḥ·šaśt mal·kā kə·nê·mā
verses.literal: Rehum the commander . . . and Shimshai the scribe wrote the letter against Jerusalem to King Artaxerxes as follows
verses.literalPt: Reum, o chanceler, e Sinsai, o escrivão, escreveram contra Jerusalém ao rei Artaxerxes uma carta do teor seguinte

verses.original: אֱדַ֜יִן רְח֣וּם בְּעֵל־ טְעֵ֗ם וְשִׁמְשַׁי֙ סָֽפְרָ֔א וּשְׁאָ֖ר כְּנָוָתְה֑וֹן דִּ֠ינָיֵא וַאֲפַרְסַתְכָיֵ֞א טַרְפְּלָיֵ֣א אֲפָֽרְסָיֵ֗א אַרְכְּוָי בָבְלָיֵא֙ שֽׁוּשַׁנְכָיֵ֔א דִּהוּא עֵלְמָיֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin rə·ḥūm bə·‘êl- ṭə·‘êm wə·šim·šay sā·p̄ə·rā ū·šə·’ār kə·nā·wā·ṯə·hō·wn dî·nā·yê wa·’ă·p̄ar·saṯ·ḵā·yê ṭar·pə·lā·yê ’ă·p̄ā·rə·sā·yê ʾar·kə·wå̄y ḇā·ḇə·lā·yê šū·šan·ḵā·yê di·hū ‘ê·lə·mā·yê
verses.literal: From Rehum the commander . . . Shimshai the scribe and the rest of their associates the judges and officials over Tripolis Persia Erech and Babylon the Elamites of Susa
verses.literalPt: (Então, escreveram Reum, o chanceler, e Sinsai, o escrivão, e o resto dos seus companheiros, os dinaítas, os afarsaquitas, os tarpelitas, os afarsitas, os arquevitas, os babilônios, os susanquitas, os deavitas, os elamitas

verses.original: וּשְׁאָ֣ר אֻמַּיָּ֗א דִּ֤י הַגְלִי֙ אָסְנַפַּר֙ רַבָּ֣א וְיַקִּירָ֔א וְהוֹתֵ֣ב הִמּ֔וֹ בְּקִרְיָ֖ה דִּ֣י שָׁמְרָ֑יִן וּשְׁאָ֥ר עֲבַֽר־ נַהֲרָ֖ה וּכְעֶֽנֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·’ār ’um·may·yā dî haḡ·lî ’ā·sə·nap·par rab·bā wə·yaq·qî·rā wə·hō·w·ṯêḇ him·mōw bə·qir·yāh dî šā·mə·rā·yin ū·šə·’ār ‘ă·ḇar- na·hă·rāh ū·ḵə·‘e·neṯ
verses.literal: and the rest of the peoples whom the great and honorable Ashurbanipal deported and settled . . . in the cities of Samaria and elsewhere west of the Euphrates . . .
verses.literalPt: e as demais nações que o grande e glorioso Asnapar transportou e pôs na cidade de Samaria e no restante do país além do rio, etc).

verses.original: דְּנָה֙ פַּרְשֶׁ֣גֶן אִגַּרְתָּ֔א דִּ֚י שְׁלַ֣חוּ עֲל֔וֹהִי עַל־ אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֖שְׂתְּא מַלְכָּ֑א עַבְדָ֛יךְ אֱנָ֥שׁ עֲבַֽר־ נַהֲרָ֖ה וּכְעֶֽנֶת׃פ
verses.transliteration: də·nāh par·še·ḡen ’ig·gar·tā dî šə·la·ḥū ‘ă·lō·w·hî ‘al- ’ar·taḥ·šaśt mal·kā ʿaḇ·ḏå̄yḵ ’ĕ·nāš ‘ă·ḇar- na·hă·rāh ū·ḵə·‘e·neṯ
verses.literal: This is the text of the letter . . . they sent to him To King Artaxerxes From your servants the men west of the Euphrates . . .
verses.literalPt: Eis a cópia da carta que enviaram ao rei Artaxerxes: Teus servos, os homens além do rio, et cetera.

verses.original: יְדִ֙יעַ֙ לֶהֱוֵ֣א לְמַלְכָּ֔א דִּ֣י יְהוּדָיֵ֗א דִּ֤י סְלִ֙קוּ֙ מִן־ לְוָתָ֔ךְ עֲלֶ֥ינָא אֲת֖וֹ לִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם קִרְיְתָ֨א מָֽרָדְתָּ֤א וּבִֽאישְׁתָּא֙ בָּנַ֔יִן וְשׁוּרַיָּ אֲשַׁכְלְלוּ וְאֻשַּׁיָּ֖א יַחִֽיטוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḏî·a‘ le·hĕ·wê lə·mal·kā dî yə·hū·ḏā·yê dî sə·li·qū min- lə·wā·ṯāḵ ‘ă·le·nā ’ă·ṯōw lî·rū·šə·lem qir·yə·ṯā mā·rā·ḏə·tā ū·ḇi·yō·šə·tå̄ bā·na·yin wə·šū·ray·yå̄ ʾă·šaḵ·lə·lū wə·’uš·šay·yā ya·ḥî·ṭū
verses.literal: Let it be known to the king that the Jews who came from you to us have returned to Jerusalem and are rebuilding that rebellious and wicked city They are restoring its walls and repairing its foundations
verses.literalPt: Saiba o rei que os judeus que de ti subiram são vindos a nós em Jerusalém. Eles estão reedificando a rebelde e péssima cidade, tendo já acabado os muros e reparado os fundamentos.

verses.original: כְּעַ֗ן יְדִ֙יעַ֙ לֶהֱוֵ֣א לְמַלְכָּ֔א דִּ֠י הֵ֣ן קִרְיְתָ֥א דָךְ֙ תִּתְבְּנֵ֔א וְשׁוּרַיָּ֖ה יִֽשְׁתַּכְלְל֑וּן מִנְדָּֽה־ בְל֤וֹ וַהֲלָךְ֙ לָ֣א יִנְתְּנ֔וּן וְאַפְּתֹ֥ם מַלְכִ֖ים תְּהַנְזִֽק׃
verses.transliteration: kə·‘an yə·ḏî·a‘ le·hĕ·wê lə·mal·kā dî hên qir·yə·ṯā ḏāḵ tiṯ·bə·nê wə·šū·ray·yāh yiš·taḵ·lə·lūn min·dāh- ḇə·lōw wa·hă·lāḵ lā yin·tə·nūn wə·’ap·pə·ṯōm mal·ḵîm tə·han·ziq
verses.literal: Let it now be known to the king that if that city is rebuilt and its walls are restored they will not pay tribute duty or toll and the royal treasury will suffer
verses.literalPt: Agora, saiba o rei que se esta cidade for reedificada e se os seus muros forem completados, não pagarão tributos, nem impostos, nem direitos de trânsito, e, por fim, isso trará dano aos reis.

verses.original: כְּעַ֗ן כָּל־ קֳבֵל֙ דִּֽי־ מְלַ֤ח הֵֽיכְלָא֙ מְלַ֔חְנָא וְעַרְוַ֣ת מַלְכָּ֔א לָ֥א אֲ‍ֽרִֽיךְ לַ֖נָא לְמֶֽחֱזֵ֑א עַ֨ל־ דְּנָ֔ה שְׁלַ֖חְנָא וְהוֹדַ֥עְנָא לְמַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: kə·‘an kāl- qo·ḇêl dî- mə·laḥ hê·ḵə·lā mə·laḥ·nā wə·‘ar·waṯ mal·kā lā ’ărîḵ- la·nā lə·me·ḥĕ·zê ‘al- də·nāh šə·laḥ·nā wə·hō·w·ḏa‘·nā lə·mal·kā
verses.literal: Now because we are in the service of the palace and it is not fitting for us to allow . . . . . . the king to be dishonored we have sent to inform the king
verses.literalPt: Agora, porque comemos o sal do palácio, e não nos convém ver a desonra do rei, por isso mandamos dar aviso ao rei,

verses.original: דִּ֡י יְבַקַּר֩ בִּֽסְפַר־ דָּכְרָ֨נַיָּ֜א דִּ֣י אֲבָהָתָ֗ךְ וּ֠תְהַשְׁכַּח בִּסְפַ֣ר דָּכְרָנַיָּא֮ וְתִנְדַּע֒ דִּי֩ קִרְיְתָ֨א דָ֜ךְ קִרְיָ֣א מָֽרָדָ֗א וּֽמְהַנְזְקַ֤ת מַלְכִין֙ וּמְדִנָ֔ן וְאֶשְׁתַּדּוּר֙ עָבְדִ֣ין בְּגַוַּ֔הּ מִן־ יוֹמָ֖ת עָלְמָ֑א עַ֨ל־ דְּנָ֔ה קִרְיְתָ֥א דָ֖ךְ הָֽחָרְבַֽת׃
verses.transliteration: dî yə·ḇaq·qar bis·p̄ar- dā·ḵə·rā·nay·yā dî ’ă·ḇā·hā·ṯāḵ ū·ṯə·haš·kaḥ bis·p̄ar dā·ḵə·rā·nay·yā wə·ṯin·da‘ dî qir·yə·ṯā ḏāḵ qir·yā mā·rā·ḏā ū·mə·han·zə·qaṯ mal·ḵîn ū·mə·ḏi·nān wə·’eš·tad·dūr ‘ā·ḇə·ḏîn bə·ḡaw·wah min- yō·w·māṯ ‘ā·lə·mā ‘al- də·nāh qir·yə·ṯā ḏāḵ hā·ḥā·rə·ḇaṯ
verses.literal: that a search should be made of the record books of your fathers In these books you will discover and verify that the city is a rebellious city harmful to kings and provinces inciting sedition from ancient times That is why this city . . . was destroyed
verses.literalPt: para que se faça um exame no Livro das Crônicas de teus pais. Assim, acharás no Livro das Crônicas e saberás que esta cidade é rebelde e danosa a reis e províncias e que de tempos antigos se têm nela excitado sedições, pelo que foi ela destruída.

verses.original: מְהוֹדְעִ֤ין אֲנַ֙חְנָה֙ לְמַלְכָּ֔א דִּ֠י הֵ֣ן קִרְיְתָ֥א דָךְ֙ תִּתְבְּנֵ֔א וְשׁוּרַיָּ֖ה יִֽשְׁתַּכְלְל֑וּן לָקֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָ֔ה חֲלָק֙ בַּעֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֔א לָ֥א אִיתַ֖י לָֽךְ׃פ
verses.transliteration: mə·hō·wḏ·‘în ’ă·naḥ·nāh lə·mal·kā dî hên qir·yə·ṯā ḏāḵ tiṯ·bə·nê wə·šū·ray·yāh yiš·taḵ·lə·lūn lā·qo·ḇêl də·nāh ḥă·lāq ba·‘ă·ḇar na·hă·rā lā ’î·ṯay lāḵ
verses.literal: We advise the king that if this city is rebuilt and its walls are restored . . . . . . you will have no dominion west of the Euphrates
verses.literalPt: Nós declaramos ao rei que, se esta cidade for reedificada e se os seus muros forem completados, sucederá que ele não terá porção além do rio.

verses.original: פִּתְגָמָ֞א שְׁלַ֣ח מַלְכָּ֗א עַל־ רְח֤וּם בְּעֵל־ טְעֵם֙ וְשִׁמְשַׁ֣י סָֽפְרָ֔א וּשְׁאָר֙ כְּנָוָ֣תְה֔וֹן דִּ֥י יָתְבִ֖ין בְּשָֽׁמְרָ֑יִן וּשְׁאָ֧ר עֲבַֽר־ נַהֲרָ֛ה שְׁלָ֖ם וּכְעֶֽת׃ס
verses.transliteration: piṯ·ḡā·mā šə·laḥ mal·kā ‘al- rə·ḥūm bə·‘êl- ṭə·‘êm wə·šim·šay sā·p̄ə·rā ū·šə·’ār kə·nā·wā·ṯə·hō·wn dî yā·ṯə·ḇîn bə·šā·mə·rā·yin ū·šə·’ār ‘ă·ḇar- na·hă·rāh šə·lām ū·ḵə·‘eṯ
verses.literal: Then the king sent this reply To Rehum the commander . . . Shimshai the scribe and the rest of your associates . . . living in Samaria and elsewhere in the region west of the Euphrates Greetings . . .
verses.literalPt: Então, enviou o rei resposta a Reum, o chanceler, e a Sinsai, o escrivão, e ao resto dos seus companheiros que habitavam em Samaria e no restante do país além do rio: Paz, etc.

verses.original: נִשְׁתְּוָנָ֕א דִּ֥י שְׁלַחְתּ֖וּן עֲלֶ֑ינָא מְפָרַ֥שׁ קֱרִ֖י קָדָמָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: niš·tə·wā·nā dî šə·laḥ·tūn ‘ă·le·nā mə·p̄ā·raš qĕ·rî qā·ḏā·māy
verses.literal: The letter . . . you sent us has been translated and read in my presence
verses.literalPt: A carta que nos enviastes foi distintamente lida na minha presença.

verses.original: וּמִנִּי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ וּבַקַּ֣רוּ וְהַשְׁכַּ֔חוּ דִּ֚י קִרְיְתָ֣א דָ֔ךְ מִן־ יוֹמָת֙ עָֽלְמָ֔א עַל־ מַלְכִ֖ין מִֽתְנַשְּׂאָ֑ה וּמְרַ֥ד וְאֶשְׁתַּדּ֖וּר מִתְעֲבֶד־ בַּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min·nî śîm ṭə·‘êm ū·ḇaq·qa·rū wə·haš·ka·ḥū dî qir·yə·ṯā ḏāḵ min- yō·w·māṯ ‘ā·lə·mā ‘al- mal·ḵîn miṯ·naś·śə·’āh ū·mə·raḏ wə·’eš·tad·dūr miṯ·‘ă·ḇeḏ- bah
verses.literal: I issued a decree and a search was conducted It was discovered that this . . . city has revolted against kings from ancient times engaging in rebellion and sedition . . .
verses.literalPt: Eu expedi um decreto, fez-se um exame e achou-se que de tempos antigos esta cidade se tem levantado contra os reis e que nela se tem excitado rebelião e sedição.

verses.original: וּמַלְכִ֣ין תַּקִּיפִ֗ין הֲווֹ֙ עַל־ יְר֣וּשְׁלֶ֔ם וְשַׁ֨לִּיטִ֔ין בְּכֹ֖ל עֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֑ה וּמִדָּ֥ה בְל֛וֹ וַהֲלָ֖ךְ מִתְיְהֵ֥ב לְהֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mal·ḵîn taq·qî·p̄în hă·wōw ‘al- yə·rū·šə·lem wə·šal·lî·ṭîn bə·ḵōl ‘ă·ḇar na·hă·rāh ū·mid·dāh ḇə·lōw wa·hă·lāḵ miṯ·yə·hêḇ lə·hō·wn
verses.literal: And mighty . . . kings have ruled over Jerusalem and exercised authority over the whole region west of the Euphrates and tribute duty and toll were paid to them
verses.literalPt: Tem havido também sobre Jerusalém reis poderosos que dominavam todo o país além do rio; a eles se lhes pagaram tributos, e impostos, e direitos de trânsito.

verses.original: כְּעַן֙ שִׂ֣ימוּ טְּעֵ֔ם לְבַטָּלָ֖א גֻּבְרַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֑ךְ וְקִרְיְתָ֥א דָךְ֙ לָ֣א תִתְבְּנֵ֔א עַד־ מִנִּ֖י טַעְמָ֥א יִתְּשָֽׂם׃
verses.transliteration: kə·‘an śî·mū ṭə·‘êm lə·ḇaṭ·ṭā·lā guḇ·ray·yā ’il·lêḵ wə·qir·yə·ṯā ḏāḵ lā ṯiṯ·bə·nê ‘aḏ- min·nî ṭa‘·mā yit·tə·śām
verses.literal: Now, therefore issue an order for these men to stop so that this city will not be rebuilt until I so order . . .
verses.literalPt: Expedi vós um decreto para que esses homens suspendam o trabalho e para que não seja edificada esta cidade sem a minha autorização.

verses.original: וּזְהִירִ֥ין הֱו֛וֹ שָׁל֖וּ לְמֶעְבַּ֣ד עַל־ דְּנָ֑ה לְמָה֙ יִשְׂגֵּ֣א חֲבָלָ֔א לְהַנְזָקַ֖ת מַלְכִֽין׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·zə·hî·rîn hĕ·wōw šā·lū lə·me‘·baḏ ‘al- də·nāh lə·māh yiś·gê ḥă·ḇā·lā lə·han·zā·qaṯ mal·ḵîn
verses.literal: See that you . . . do not neglect . . . . . . this matter Why allow this threat to increase and the royal interests to suffer
verses.literalPt: Guardai-vos não sejais remissos nesse negócio; por que há de crescer o dano em prejuízo dos reis?

verses.original: אֱדַ֗יִן מִן־ דִּ֞י פַּרְשֶׁ֤גֶן נִשְׁתְּוָנָא֙ דִּ֚י אַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתָּא מַלְכָּ֔א קֱרִ֧י קֳדָם־ רְח֛וּם וְשִׁמְשַׁ֥י סָפְרָ֖א וּכְנָוָתְה֑וֹן אֲזַ֨לוּ בִבְהִיל֤וּ לִירֽוּשְׁלֶם֙ עַל־ יְה֣וּדָיֵ֔א וּבַטִּ֥לוּ הִמּ֖וֹ בְּאֶדְרָ֥ע וְחָֽיִל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin min- dî par·še·ḡen niš·tə·wā·nā dî ʾar·taḥ·šaś·tå̄ mal·kā qĕ·rî qo·ḏām- rə·ḥūm wə·šim·šay sā·p̄ə·rā ū·ḵə·nā·wā·ṯə·hō·wn ’ă·za·lū ḇiḇ·hî·lū lî·rū·šə·lem ‘al- yə·hū·ḏā·yê ū·ḇaṭ·ṭi·lū him·mōw bə·’eḏ·rā‘ wə·ḥā·yil
verses.literal: When . . . . . . the text of the letter from King Artaxerxes was read to Rehum Shimshai the scribe and their associates they went immediately to the Jews in Jerusalem and forcibly . . . stopped them
verses.literalPt: Então, quando a cópia da carta do rei Artaxerxes foi lida perante Reum, e Sinsai, o escrivão, e seus companheiros, foram a toda a pressa a Jerusalém aos judeus e, de mão armada, fizeram-lhes cessar a obra.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֗יִן בְּטֵלַת֙ עֲבִידַ֣ת בֵּית־ אֱלָהָ֔א דִּ֖י בִּירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וַהֲוָת֙ בָּֽטְלָ֔א עַ֚ד שְׁנַ֣ת תַּרְתֵּ֔ין לְמַלְכ֖וּת דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ פָּרָֽס׃פ
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin bə·ṭê·laṯ ‘ă·ḇî·ḏaṯ bêṯ- ’ĕ·lā·hā dî bî·rū·šə·lem wa·hă·wāṯ bā·ṭə·lā ‘aḏ šə·naṯ tar·tên lə·mal·ḵūṯ dā·rə·yā·weš me·leḵ- pā·rās
verses.literal: Thus the construction of the house of God . . . in Jerusalem ceased and it remained at a standstill until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia
verses.literalPt: A obra da Casa de Deus, que está em Jerusalém, foi interrompida até o segundo ano do reinado de Dario, rei da Pérsia.
